params.tumour_sample_code: 01 = primary solid tumour (used); 11 = adjacent normal (kept separately); 06 = metastatic (dropped)
params.vial_dedup_rule: if a patient has >1 primary-tumour vial in STAR counts, keep vial 01A (checked: 01A is the better match to HiSeqV2 in 11/11; 4 of these 11 patients still fail the identity QC and are excluded)
params.HER2_rule: v1 (used): (1) ISH/FISH Positive -> pos, FISH Negative -> neg (FISH has precedence). (2) Without a conclusive FISH, IHC score her2_immunohistochemistry_level_result: 3+ -> pos, 0/1+ -> neg, 2+ -> missing (equivocal). (3) If the score is blank, fall back to the IHC status text (Positive/Negative). (4) If status text and score contradict (status Positive with score 0/1+, or Negative with 3+) and there is no FISH -> missing. (5) IHC 3+ with a negative FISH is discordant (IHC 3+ alone is positive under ASCO/CAP) -> missing. HER2_confidence = low for calls that rest on the IHC status text alone (no score, no FISH). v0 (team plan, kept as HER2_v0 for sensitivity): FISH overrides IHC status text; IHC equivocal without FISH = missing.
params.clinical_group_rule: needs ER, PR and HER2 all known; HER2+ if HER2 pos; else HR+/HER2- if ER or PR pos; else TNBC
params.ERneg_HER2neg_rule: ER neg and HER2 neg (PR ignored, to match METABRIC)
params.exclusions_all_analyses: (a) sample identity not confirmed: same-tumour Spearman between HiSeqV2 and STAR log2-CPM < 0.8, or below the 99th percentile of between-patient Spearman, or the tumour's own STAR profile is not its best match in both directions; (b) case flagged 'Redacted' in TCGA-CDR (Liu 2018); the adjacent normals of redacted cases are dropped too
params.identity_qc_genes: HGNC genes present on both platforms with HiSeqV2 mean log2 > 2; STAR as log2(CPM + 1), Ensembl IDs collapsed per HGNC symbol by maximum; Spearman via ranks
params.expression_sex: Male if RPS4Y1 > 6 and XIST < 6; Female if XIST >= 6; otherwise unclear (used only when the recorded sex is blank)
params.supervised_set: tumours not excluded AND female (recorded sex, or XIST/RPS4Y1 expression when the record is blank); the 12 male patients are kept for unsupervised analyses only (male breast cancer differs in biology; too few to model)
params.histology_collapse: IDC = Infiltrating Ductal; ILC = Infiltrating Lobular; Other = everything else incl. mixed and blank
params.stage_collapse: Stage I/IA/IB -> I; II/IIA/IIB -> II; III*/IV -> III-IV; X, blank, [Discrepancy] -> missing
params.pam50_main: PanCanAtlas TCGASubtype.20170308 Subtype_mRNA (Xena PAM50Call_RNAseq is a subset of the same calls)
params.hiseq_gene_filter_at_freeze: drop genes with zero variance across the analysed tumours (no other filter at freeze)
params.star_count_conversion: counts = round(2**x - 1) from Xena log2(count+1), np.rint (half to even). Non-integers are exact .5 values confined to a few 01A columns that the hub stored as the mean of two aliquots (flagged star_averaged_aliquots)
params.star_gene_filter: >= 10 counts in >= n_min analysed primary tumours, n_min = size of the smallest clinical group in the supervised set with STAR counts (computed at run time, logged as star_min_samples)
params.gene_harmonisation: HGNC complete set: approved symbol > Entrez ID (incl. IDs embedded in LOC<id> / ?|<id> names) > Ensembl ID > unique previous symbol > unique alias; otherwise keep the original name (method 'unmapped')
params.duplicate_gene_rule: when several rows map to one HGNC symbol keep the row with the highest mean expression
params.sex_specific_genes: chrY genes (GENCODE v36) plus XIST and TSIX; listed in sex_specific_genes.txt and removed from unsupervised gene sets
params.rppa: primary tumours only; phospho/cleaved antibodies flagged and excluded from mRNA-protein concordance (not collapsed); pan-isoform antibodies flagged isoform_ambiguous
params.metabric_her2_label: HER2_SNP6 GAIN = gained; NEUTRAL/LOSS = not gained; UNDEF = missing
params.metabric_missing_values: genes with >5% missing dropped; remaining missing values imputed by the gene median
params.low_library_rule: flag (not drop) STAR samples with total counts below 25% of the median
